title: Monitor&\#x27;s USB Ethernet Path Cut Download Speed by 75%
summary: The blog post traces a 75% download-speed loss to the USB networking path built into a monitor, not to the Ethernet link itself. Extra latency through the monitor&\#x27;s USB hub delayed packet acknowledgements; the Ethernet adapter&\#x27;s buffer filled and began dropping packets. A different adapter that required less frequent acknowledgement resolved the problem.
